text: As a child, Theo was fascinated by the stars and spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home. This love for astronomy was more than just a hobby; it was a bond with his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. She taught him that the rain which eventually nourished their garden did not come from nowhere, but from fluffy things in the sky, a gentle explanation that grounded his cosmic wonder in the tangible world. Now, as an adult, Theo works as a meteorologist, driven by a deep-seated need to understand the water cycle that connects the heavens to the earth, honoring his mother’s legacy by explaining how those fluffy clouds release the rain that sustains life.
